notifications.title: The evaluator fails on a Python without numpy (generator/variety.py is yours to change)
notifications.detail: `python -m improvement.evaluate` imports generator/variety.py, which imports KEYS, GENRES and BPM_RANGE from renderer/engine/music.py, which imports numpy. Research hit ModuleNotFoundError on a plain Python 3.11 on 2026-10-18. Agents can't edit variety.py (guard: owner-only).
notifications.fix: 1. Create renderer/engine/music_constants.py holding KEYS, GENRES and BPM_RANGE (cut from music.py). 2. In music.py: `from .music_constants import BPM_RANGE, GENRES, KEYS`. 3. In generator/variety.py line 12: `from renderer.engine.music_constants import BPM_RANGE, GENRES, KEYS`. 4. Check renderer/engine/style.py (variety.py line 13 imports PALETTES from it) is numpy-free too. 5. Run `python -m pytest renderer generator improvement -q`. Or tell the improver it may make step 3.
